Aisha (People Ops): Heads up — Jin's last day is next Friday 2026-04-10. We need to align final invoice cutoff, visa/consulate letter, COBRA opt-in timing, asset return, and IT deprovision. Can people confirm owners? :wave:

Jin (Contractor): Confirmed — 4/10 is my last billable day. I have the company laptop at home and the serial/tag. Also need a signed consulate letter for visa stamping.

Mark (Engineering): I can be Jin's handover buddy. Propose two 30m sessions this week to capture runbooks and a short recorded walkthrough. @Sam (IT) can you handle deprovision timing?

Sam (IT): Yep. I'll create an offboard ticket and schedule deprovision. Standard: revoke SSO + API tokens day-of, remove VPN 24h after last day, confirm asset receipt to close. Jin — can you confirm shipping address and asset tag/serial?

Jin (Contractor): Shipping address: 123 Cedar St, Apt 4B, Seattle, WA 98101. Laptop tag LT-4721, serial SN12345. I can drop the package 4/11.

Aisha (People Ops): Payroll/finance note: @finance — we need final invoice cutoff for contractor pay and any pro-rated bonuses. Also Ross, can you draft the consulate letter? COBRA: People Ops will send opt-in notice within 14 days after termination (we aim to email on 4/11).

Ross (Legal): I’ll draft the consulate letter today and cc Aisha. Quick reminder: the contractor agreement has a post-termination IP/confidentiality clause — please confirm no client data is retained locally.

Jin (Contractor): I don’t have client data copies locally. I’ll run a quick check and purge anything flagged. Example command I’ll run:
```
find ~/workspace -type f -name '*.json' -or -name '*.csv' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'file {} || true'
rm -v ~/workspace/**/*.cache || true
```
I’ll also sign a return/deletion confirmation.

Sam (IT): offboard-bot created ticket #OF-3321 for this workflow. Plan in ticket:
```
- Day 0 (2026-04-10): disable SSO, revoke API keys
- Day 1 (2026-04-11): remove VPN access, attach shipping label
- Day 3 (by 2026-04-13): confirm asset received -> close ticket
```
Shipping label will be attached to the ticket.

offboard-bot: Ticket #OF-3321 created by Sam. Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-12 to confirm delivery.

Mark (Engineering): Handover sessions: Tue 09:30-10:00 PST and Wed 15:00-15:30 PST. I’ll record and drop notes into /shared/runbooks/jin-project.md and create follow-ups for anything that needs longer-term coverage.

Aisha (People Ops): Jin — do you prefer COBRA docs emailed or mailed? Also would you be open to a 20-min exit interview on 2026-04-09? Zoom is fine.

Jin (Contractor): Email for COBRA is fine. Exit interview 4/9 at 11:00am works for me. Thanks everyone — appreciate the support.

Aisha (People Ops): Great, I’ll send calendar invites and the COBRA email on 4/11. Ben in Finance — please confirm final invoice cutoff and payment ETA.

Ross (Legal): Drafted consulate letter attached to my reply (sending now). Aisha, tag me if you need edits for wording for consulate requirements.

Sam (IT): Shipping label attached to OF-3321. Jin — please drop off by end of day 4/11 so we can close by 4/13.

offboard-bot: Reminder: COBRA packet will be queued for send on unix 1767610000.

Mark (Engineering): Adding myself to the exit interview invite. I want to ask about a few undocumented operational quirks.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all — owners: Aisha (COBRA/email + interview), Sam (IT offboard), Mark (handover/runbook), Ross (consulate letter/legal). If anyone hits a blocker ping here or DM me. :thumbsup:
